items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore is inactive; Josh Palmer is active vs Raiders.
items.implication: BUF WR targets shift to Palmer and others; Moore owners scramble.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for active BUF WRs

items.text: Colts TE Tyler Warren is inactive today vs Titans after appearing on injury report.
items.implication: TE streaming needed; opens targets for Colts pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: TE streamers and IND WR/RB targets

items.text: Browns RB Quinshon Judkins (ankle), who was questionable, is out/inactive today vs Ravens. Only Jaleel McLaughlin and Audric Estime available in backfield.
items.why: Ankle injury; limited practice Friday, pregame workout not enough.
items.implication: Thin CLE RB depth; volume to McLaughlin/Estime; Judkins first miss of season.

items.text: Actives today include Caleb Williams, Rico Dowdle, Chris Olave, Alvin Kamara, Kenyon Sadiq, Ja’Kobi Lane. Inactives: Judkins, Warren.
items.implication: Clear starts for expected players; Kamara/Olave/Caleb locked in.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson and LT Will Campbell (both Q) officially active; AJ Brown returning, NE close to full health.
items.why: Sources indicated likely; confirmed active with Brown back.
items.implication: NE offense near healthy; Henderson role intact, Brown targets available.

items.text: Whoa on Tyler Warren inactive (surprising). Juwan Johnson, Freiermuth and Higbee among favorite streamer TEs.
Titans RB Tyjae Spears is active today vs Colts.
items.why: Knee; full practice Friday after limited/out earlier.
items.implication: Change-of-pace role behind Pollard; weak flex option.

items.text: Updated ranks: Cam Skattebo at RB28, Najee Harris RB33. Still starting Cam for explosiveness/TD chance vs NO but riskier flex than RB2 now due to rotation/fumbles; prefer Najee over DK Metcalf sometimes for TD upside.
items.why: Rotation change with Najee larger role post-fumbles; still best shot at score.
items.opportunity: Reduced but still viable vs soft NO run D

items.text: Cam Skattebo currently 37th out of 43 qualifying RBs in rush yards over expectation. He's also fumbled four times (lost one). Expectation of larger Najee Harris role with Skattebo downgraded but still in mix; all 4 RBs active.
items.why: Poor YOE efficiency + 4 fumbles; beat report on rotation change.
items.implication: Riskier flex; Najee upside rises in split vs NO.
items.opportunity: Najee larger share; Skattebo still explosive but reduced

items.text: Weekend FF reports summary: GTD Judkins, Warren, Mike Evans/Christian Kirk; Expected Caleb Williams, Olave/Kamara, AJ Brown/Henderson, DK Metcalf, Freiermuth, Sadiq; Not expected Deebo, Croskey-Merritt, Tucker; Activated Jaydon Blue.
items.why: Compiled weekend reports for last-minute decisions.
items.implication: Core status tracking; projections hub live; monitor GTD windows.
items.opportunity: Role clarity for expected players; backups for outs

items.text: Loves Mike Evans vs WSH (WR4) due to Commanders defense being a buffet for pass catchers.
Loves Drake London vs CHI (WR6) with bankable usage.
Loves George Kittle vs WSH (TE3) as Commanders D nightmare for TEs.
Loves Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5) for elite recent usage vs leaky run D.
Hates Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (WR28) due to tough matchup and QB issues.
Hates Emeka Egbuka vs PIT (WR34) for lack of recent targets and tough spot.
items.why: Struggled for targets lately + PIT D.
